location.en: Number 5 bus to the language school
location.zh: 開往語言學校的 5 號公車

goal.en: Get off the crowded bus politely, using the right magic words.
goal.zh: 在擁擠的公車上用對三個魔法詞，有禮貌地下車。

background: inside an empty city bus, rows of blue fabric seats, yellow handrails and hanging straps, large windows showing a sunny harbor street, rubber floor, morning light

intro.en: Today you visit the language school for the first time. You take the number 5 bus, and it's packed.
intro.zh: 今天你第一次去語言學校看看。你搭上 5 號公車，車上擠滿了人。

intro.en: Your stop is next. But a tall guy with a giant backpack is standing between you and the door, listening to music.
intro.zh: 下一站就要下車了。可是一個背著超大背包的高個子擋在你和車門之間，正在聽音樂。

choices.en: Excuse me, can I get by?
choices.zh: 不好意思，借過一下好嗎？
choices.tip: 要從別人身邊經過時說 Excuse me，加上 can I get by? 更清楚。

lines.en: Borrow my pass? Sorry, I need my bus pass!
lines.zh: 借我的票卡？抱歉，我自己要用啦！

story.en: Max holds his bus pass tight and doesn't move. The doors close, and you ride two extra stops.
story.zh: 麥克斯緊緊抓著他的公車票卡，動也不動。車門關上，你多坐了兩站。

fail.why: 「借過」的「借」不是 borrow，英文聽起來像要跟他借東西。要從別人身邊過去，說 Excuse me, can I get by?

choices.en: Hey! Move! Your bag is too big!
choices.zh: 喂！讓開！你的包包太大了！

lines.en: Whoa, okay. You could just say "excuse me."
lines.zh: 哇，好啦。你說一聲「借過」就好了嘛。

story.en: Max moves, but half the bus is now staring at you. You get off with a face as red as a maple leaf.
story.zh: 麥克斯讓開了，但半車的人都在盯著你。你下車時，臉紅得像一片楓葉。

fail.why: 對陌生人喊 Move! 很不客氣，還批評人家的包包更失禮。借過只要說 Excuse me, can I get by?

lines.en: As you squeeze past, the bus brakes hard. You step right on his foot.
lines.zh: 你正要擠過去時，公車突然急煞。你一腳踩在他的腳上。

choices.en: Oh no, I'm so sorry! Are you okay?
choices.zh: 糟糕，真的很對不起！你還好嗎？
choices.tip: 自己不小心弄到別人時說 Sorry，再關心一句 Are you okay?

lines.en: Excuse you? You just stepped on my foot!
lines.zh: 不好意思？你剛剛踩到我的腳耶！

story.en: To Max, it sounds like you want his foot out of your way. He limps to the back of the bus, grumbling.
story.zh: 在麥克斯聽來，你好像是嫌他的腳擋路。他一跛一跛地走到車尾，嘴裡碎碎念。

fail.why: 中文「不好意思」可以是 Excuse me，也可以是 Sorry。踩到人是你的錯，要用 Sorry 道歉；Excuse me 是借過或引起注意。

choices.en: Not my fault. The driver did it.
choices.zh: 不是我的錯，是司機害的。

lines.zh: 真的假的？連一聲「對不起」都沒有？

story.en: The bus driver stares at you in the mirror for a long time. Max rubs his foot and turns away.
story.zh: 司機從後照鏡盯了你好久。麥克斯揉著腳，轉過身去不理你。

fail.why: 就算是急煞造成的，踩到人還是要先道歉。英語國家的人很常說 Sorry，說一句不代表你全錯：I'm so sorry! Are you okay?

lines.en: Hey, wait. Is this your phone? It was on the floor.
lines.zh: 嘿，等一下。這是你的手機嗎？剛剛掉在地上。

choices.tip: 別人幫你忙時，說 Thank you so much! 最直接。

choices.en: Sorry, sorry! Sorry to trouble you!
choices.zh: 不好意思，不好意思！麻煩你了！

lines.en: Why are you sorry? I just picked it up.
lines.zh: 你為什麼要道歉？我只是撿起來而已。

story.en: Max looks worried, like he did something wrong. You both keep apologizing until the doors close again.
story.zh: 麥克斯一臉擔心，好像自己做錯了什麼。你們互相道歉，直到車門又關上了。

fail.why: 別人幫你時，台灣人習慣說「不好意思，麻煩你了」，但英文要說 Thank you，而不是 Sorry。一直道歉，對方會以為出了什麼問題。

lines.en: You're welcome? Uh... thanks? For what?

story.en: Max says thanks, so you say you're welcome again. While you two go in circles, you miss your stop.
story.zh: 麥克斯說謝謝，你又回了一次不客氣。你們兩個繞來繞去，結果你坐過站了。

fail.why: You're welcome 是回應別人的 Thank you，不是用來道謝的。別人幫你撿東西，要說 Thank you so much!

lines.en: No problem. Have a good day!
lines.zh: 不客氣。祝你今天順利喔！

lines.en: You hop off at the right stop, phone safe in your pocket.
lines.zh: 你在對的站下車，手機穩穩地收在口袋裡。

story.en: Excuse me, sorry, thank you. With three little words, a crowded bus feels much friendlier. Your day is off to a great start.
story.zh: 借過、對不起、謝謝。靠著三個小小的詞，擁擠的公車也變得友善多了。這一天，有個好的開始。

notes.en: Excuse me, can I get by?
notes.explain: 要從別人身邊經過，或要引起陌生人注意時，用 Excuse me。「借過」不是 borrow。

example.en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
example.zh: 不好意思，請問這個位子有人坐嗎？

notes.en: I'm so sorry! Are you okay?
notes.zh: 真的很對不起！你還好嗎？
notes.explain: 自己做錯事，例如踩到人、撞到人時，用 Sorry 道歉。再加一句 Are you okay? 更有誠意。

example.en: Sorry! I didn't see you there.
example.zh: 對不起！我剛剛沒看到你。

notes.explain: 別人幫你忙時用 Thank you，不要用 Sorry 代替。對方會回 You're welcome. 或 No problem.

example.en: Thank you so much for your help!

notes.en: Excuse me, sorry or thank you?
notes.explain: 中文「不好意思」一詞多用，英文要分清楚：借過、引起注意說 Excuse me；做錯事說 Sorry；別人幫忙說 Thank you。

example.en: Excuse me. Oh, sorry! Thank you!
example.zh: 借過一下。啊，對不起！謝謝你！

notes.explain: 英語國家的人就算是很小的事，也會說 please、sorry、thank you、excuse me。下公車時對司機說 Thank you! 也很常見。

example.zh: 謝謝，祝你有美好的一天！
